name: Prevent Force Push
description: Blocks any git push --force or git push -f command before it executes, preventing accidental history rewrites on shared branches.
author: anthropics

name: Block rm -rf
description: Intercepts Bash tool calls and exits with an error if the command contains rm -rf, protecting against accidental recursive deletions.
author: anthropics

name: Auto Prettier
description: Runs Prettier on any file that was just written or edited by Claude, ensuring consistent code formatting without manual intervention.
author: prettier

name: ESLint Auto-Fix
description: Automatically runs eslint --fix on modified JavaScript and TypeScript files after each edit, keeping the codebase lint-clean in real time.
author: eslint

name: Slack Notifier
description: Sends a Slack message to a configured channel when Claude finishes responding, useful for long-running background sessions.
author: slackapi

name: Desktop Notification
description: Fires a macOS or Linux desktop notification via osascript/notify-send when Claude stops, so you can step away and get called back.
author: anthropics

name: Tool Usage Logger
description: Appends a JSON log entry for every tool Claude uses, recording the tool name, arguments, and timestamp to a local file for auditing.
author: anthropics

name: Prompt Logger
description: Logs every user prompt to a local markdown file with a timestamp, giving you a searchable archive of every instruction you gave Claude.
author: anthropics

name: Auto Test Runner
description: Runs the project's test suite after every file edit and blocks Claude from continuing if tests fail, enforcing a green-tests-always policy.
author: anthropics

name: TypeScript Type Check
description: Runs tsc --noEmit after TypeScript file edits and surfaces compiler errors as hook output so Claude can fix them in the same session.
author: microsoft

name: Auto Commit
description: Stages all changes and creates a git commit with an AI-generated message every time Claude finishes a response, creating a fine-grained history.
author: anthropics

name: Secret Scanner
description: Scans file contents for API keys, tokens, and passwords before writing them to disk, blocking accidental credential leaks.
author: trufflesecurity

name: Dependency Auditor
description: Runs npm audit or pip-audit whenever a dependency file changes and fails loudly if high-severity vulnerabilities are found.
author: snyk

name: Token Counter
description: Estimates and logs the token count of each user prompt before it is sent, helping you monitor context usage across a long session.
author: anthropics
